get: This tool sends a confirmation or certificate.

Use this as a general-purpose helper.
Example tool suspend_line: Suspends a specific line (max 6 months).
Example tool resume_line: Resumes a suspended line.
send: This tool transfers the conversation to a human agent.
Use this to escalate when automated handling fails.
Example tool transfer_to_human_agents: Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
transfer: This tool retrieves details about a specific entity.
Use this to fetch the current state of a record.
Example tool get_customer_by_phone: Finds a customer by their primary contact or line phone number.
Example tool get_customer_by_id: Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.

entity: This tool primarily takes an identifier as input.
Use this to act on a record referenced by its id.
Example tool get_customer_by_id: Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.
Example tool get_details_by_id: Retrieves the details for a given ID.
identifier: This tool primarily takes a free-text query as input.
Use this when searching by name or phrase.

device: This tool performs a utility action not tied to a domain.
Use this for arithmetic, escalation, or generic helpers.

classifications.name: get_customer_by_phone
classifications.docstring:
Finds a customer by their primary contact or line phone number.

    phone_number: The phone number to search for.

Returns:
    Customer object if found, None otherwise.

classifications.name: get_customer_by_id
classifications.docstring:
Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.

Args:
    customer_id: The unique identifier of the customer.

Returns:
    Customer object if found, None otherwise.
